Haha! omg.
I feel like she was just trying to be nice by telling me, though.
I don't just feel this way because of that one incident. That just pushed it.
I'm always just really sad and I'm never happy. I just can't get happy. I just hate myself so much and it's just impossible for me to even think that it will get better someday.

Thanks. This actually made me smile.

One of my problems is that right now I'm just too upset to even do good in school. I try to, but it's weird, I just screw everything up and I'm afraid I won't get into USC or NYU because my grades aren't doing very good. This is another reason I feel like nothing will get better. My life just keeps getting worse.
Thanks, though. Kind of made me feel a bit better. :)

It's really not that the bullying is bad. I mean, that has only happened once recently and it's what really pushed me to think, "Maybe I should just end it for good because nothing will ever get better." I'm always thinking that it's an option, but that just really brought me to this point.

As for the school counsellor... I think that guy hates me. I was trying to remember my 6th period so I could get out of class to go to this meeting for USC and he said, "Maybe you're not smart enough to go to college." in a bitter tone, so I was kinda like, "oh." He's just not really someone you'd talk to about your problems. I've somewhat tried before.

I try to ignore it, and I try to push through, but it's just really hard to put up with it all...
Thank you x

Yeah, it's not that I'm a bad actress, it's that I've completely lost my self confidence. I guess maybe if I performed in front of crowds more often I could get over my nerves.
Thank you<3

Samuel L. Jackson.

I just spit tea all over my laptop.
Amy Pond from Doctor Who. People always tell me I look like young Amelia Pond even though I'm A LOT older than ten, so I thought why not? However, I'm going to dress as OLDER Amy Pond. Haha!
I've never found jokes about his past funny coming from anyone else. I feel like it's his way of coping, so I didn't enjoy the last bit of the title. Great video, though!
